_info: Compiled 2026-10-12 for BOM colour swatches. Hex: ORACAL 8500 and 551 from Orafol-published sRGB (EU product pages; 8500 'hex' = natural-light view, 'hex_backlit' = back-lit view). Avery and 3M publish no RGB values -> hex are on-screen approximations (approx:true); never use them for colour matching - use the physical colour card. Codes only as found in manufacturer sources; see sources.md.

ORACAL 8500.type: translucent calendered (Translucent Cal), matt, for backlit signs
ORACAL 8500._info: 54 colours on Orafol EU page (swatch ids carry suffix 'S', e.g. 010S). Americas page additionally lists 015 Yellow (not in EU range). No 019 in 8500. 330 is 'Bright orange' (EU) / 'Fox red' (AU/US). Order code format: 8500-031.

330.name: Bright orange
330.note: EU page names it 'Bright orange'; AU/US pages name it 'Fox red' (same sRGB)

ORACAL 551.type: opaque calendered (High Performance Cal - polymeric calendered, NOT cast)
ORACAL 551._info: 86 colours on Orafol EU page; swatch id suffix G = gloss, M = matt (027, 603, 073 had no suffix). 702 exists = Deep black MATT (702M); 701 = Deep black gloss. There is no 070 in 551. 101/102 = Arctic white gloss/matt.

AVERY 4500._info: Avery EU states 38 stock colours. 32 read from the Translucent Films colour card + 6 (4514, 4519, 4520, 4522, 4529, 4534) from technical bulletin TB 3.23 = 38. Code format e.g. '4506 TF'. Hex approximate.

TB 3.23 also mentions 5535 Berry Red, 5539 New Blue, 5557 Pistachio, 5559 Bright Green - not on current card, omitted. 5600 LD light-diffusing variants exist for 5500/5510-01/5516-01/5521/5547/5550. Blockout: 5301 white, 5303 black. Hex approximate.

AVERY 777.type: opaque cast (777 Cast Film) - NOT translucent
AVERY 777._info: 100 stock colours (Avery: 'no less than 100'). 777-002 = Sweet Red Gloss. Suffix in drawings like '777-002CF' is not in the colour list (likely an ordering/liner suffix) - unverified. Hex approximate.

3M 3630.type: translucent (Scotchcal Translucent Graphic Film Series 3630), satin matte
3M 3630._info: 78 colours (matches count stated in 3M 3630/3730 product bulletin; list from the bulletin's colour overview page, US edition). 3M EU availability per colour not verified (EU product page shows no colour list). Official digital colour card (multimedia.3m.com ...2087726O) could not be fetched. 3M writes 2-digit codes without leading zero (3630-33) but 015/005 with one. 3630-22 Black and 3630-69 Duranodic effectively opaque. LED-optimised 3730 series (25 colours) not included. Hex approximate.
